Allowed address lookups go to Cloudflare without encryption. Read Privacy for the details.
Help Pause stay on while you use other apps
If your phone closes Pause, protection and list updates stop. This optional step helps it stay on.

Open the settings for Pause, find Battery or App battery usage, and allow background activity. Choose Unrestricted if available. Names vary by phone and Android version. This choice may increase battery use.

In Settings → Battery → Background usage limits, add Pause to Never auto sleeping apps. Remove it from Sleeping apps or Deep sleeping apps if listed there. On some Galaxy phones, Battery is under Device care.

In the settings for Pause, choose Battery saver → No restrictions. Also allow Background autostart, if available under Apps → Permissions. These options may appear on different screens in MIUI and HyperOS.
In Apps → Pause → App battery usage, allow background usage. On some versions, tap the text beside the switch as well to see the options.
If you use a feature that closes all apps, exclude Pause from cleanup or lock its card in recent apps if your phone supports it. This also applies to other Android brands.
Look for “Protection is on” on the home screen. If needed, turn it on again. Battery settings alone do not start protection or prevent every shutdown.
Open Android Settings → Apps → Pause manually and look for Battery or background activity.

If ads still appear or an app will not open
What Pause uses and what stays on your phone
Check that Pause is on, then reopen the app or reload the website. Ads already downloaded may still appear.
Pause protection and try again. If the app works again, you can exclude it from filtering.
A reward video will not play?
Filtering may also block videos that give rewards. Pause protection to watch them; rewards depend on the game.
Pause reduces ads in many games, apps and websites. Some ads may remain, especially in YouTube and Instagram. A game may also show an empty ad window or wait for an ad.
Selected apps use your connection without filtering. They may show ads.
Pause protection to edit this list.
No apps found. Try another name.
Could not load apps. Go back and try again.
Pause checks requests against known ad-blocking lists on your phone. Your other traffic uses your normal connection.
No account, subscription or analytics. Pause does not read or decrypt the content of your games or websites.
Allowed requests are forwarded to Cloudflare, which can see the requested domains. This DNS connection is not encrypted. Pause is not a VPN for anonymity or changing your location.
Your settings and statistics stay on your phone, outside backups. The last 30 blocked addresses stay in memory only. Pause does not upload this data.

StevenBlack and HaGeZi Normal are included. While protection is on, Pause checks for updates about once a day from GitHub over HTTPS. You can also update manually. If a download fails or is invalid, the previous protection remains. Your custom rules stay unchanged.
You do not need to change anything here for everyday use. Custom rules may affect how apps work.
Recently blocked domains, kept in memory only
Requests checked: %1$s\nDomains on the list: %2$s\nDNS errors detected: %3$s
Counters measure DNS requests, not ads removed. Totals are kept from installation.

Custom Private DNS or encrypted DNS inside an app may interfere with filtering. For a test, temporarily turn off Private DNS in Android settings. Do not enable “Block connections without VPN”: Pause routes DNS requests only. Start protection manually; always-on VPN is not supported. Some Android versions do not provide the source of DNS requests. Pause does not guess from the foreground app.
Allowed domains always take priority. Each rule also covers subdomains.
Enter only the domain, without https:// or a path.
Blocked domains will appear here while you use apps with protection on. History stays in phone memory only.
Tap a domain to allow it if needed to restore an app feature.
Allow this domain and its subdomains? This may restore an app feature and some advertising.

StevenBlack, HaGeZi Normal and list licenses
